description: Figures what a 2026 or 2027 (tax_year; 2027 on the IRS's published 2027 amounts, the state line on each state's 2026 rules, labelled) health FSA or HSA contribution saves in federal income tax, Social Security and Medicare tax and state income tax: the same return with and without the contribution, a payroll contribution taken out of W-2 boxes 1, 3 and 5, a direct HSA contribution out of the income tax only (no FICA saving); California (HSA) and New Jersey (HSA and FSA), which tax the contribution, show no state saving. Returns each saving, the total, the after-tax cost, an optional FSA forfeiture estimate and every default assumed. Computed by QuantCalc's federal and state tax APIs, the engines the website's FSA and HSA limit pages are checked against to the cent. Requires a connected QuantCalc PRO licence or Tax Season Pass; without one it returns no figures and names the free web calculator. Not tax advice.

account.description: fsa: a health flexible spending account (always a payroll salary reduction). hsa: a health savings account.

age.description: The age the filer reaches in the tax year (16-110). Default 40, stated in the result.

amount.description: The contribution for the tax year in dollars (more than 0; a payroll contribution is at most the filer's wages).

expected_spend.description: fsa only: the eligible expenses expected in the plan year; with it the result estimates the unspent amount the plan forfeits.

filing_status.description: Filing status: single, married filing jointly (mfj), married filing separately (mfs) or head of household (hoh).

plan_carryover.description: fsa only, with expected_spend: the most the employer's plan carries into the next plan year (0 if the plan has no carryover). Default 0.

route.description: hsa only: payroll (through the employer's cafeteria plan: saves income tax and Social Security and Medicare tax) or direct (made outside payroll and deducted on the return: no FICA saving). Default payroll, stated in the result.

spouse_age.description: Joint return only: the spouse's age in the tax year. Default: the same as age.

spouse_wages.description: Joint return only: the spouse's own W-2 wages. Default 0.

state.description: Optional two-letter state of residence, or DC: adds the state tax saving. California (HSA) and New Jersey (HSA and FSA) tax the contribution, so they show no state saving.

tax_year.description: 2026 (default) or 2027. 2027: the federal tax on the IRS's published 2027 brackets (Rev. Proc. 2026-35), FICA on SSA's published 2027 wage base, the state's 2026 rules; stated in the result.

wages.description: The filer's W-2 wages (box 1) before the contribution: the paycheck it comes out of.

name: pretax_contribution_savings
title: Tax saved by a health FSA or HSA contribution (2026 or 2027)
